<!-- Search existing issues before submitting. Fill in the sections below and
     remove optional sections that do not apply. -->

### Problem or use case

What are you trying to accomplish with DepthAI ROS? Describe the limitation or
missing capability and who would benefit from addressing it.

### Proposed behavior

Describe what you would like DepthAI ROS to do. Include a concrete example of
how you would use the feature and what a successful result would look like.
If relevant, describe any new or changed ROS topics, services, parameters,
messages, or launch options.

### Alternatives or workarounds

Describe any existing options you have considered or tried and why they do not
meet your needs. If you have no workaround, say so.

### Additional context (optional)

Add examples, diagrams, related issues, or links that help explain the request.
Implementation ideas and compatibility considerations are welcome, but not necessary.
